findings.disposition: Treat ERTS SMP/thread progress as a Gate-0 kill criterion and detect lost wake, premature block, stalled startup, scheduler stall, and exit/join failure without accepting a valve.
Require ordered child-TID publication, clear-on-exit, futex wake, join completion, and generation-safe reclamation.
Do not inherit the success stub; derive and test the pinned musl robust-list lifecycle.
Require real action, mask, delivery, frame, return, interruption, restart, and synchronous-fault semantics.
Derive AArch64 QEMU virt, GIC, timer, TLS, CPU-feature, auxv, and weak-memory contracts independently.
Keep Linux TCG, native AArch64 KVM, and Apple Silicon HVF evidence separate and non-substitutable.
Record the source/ELF/build inspection, but make no boot or rate claim until an x86_64 KVM runner executes the pinned image.
Retain separate EL0 address spaces, validated user-copy, guard pages, W^X, and contained faults as project requirements.
Preserve first failure artifacts and classify RAM/layout/profile failures rather than relabeling them as slow emulation.
Use the project's non-JIT artifact and prohibit arbitrary NIFs/drivers; Tyn's executable-mmap and static-NIF path is not imported.
Persistent and general writable storage remain out of scope; do not import Tyn's tmpfs implementation.
Networking, DNS, TLS, and distribution claims neither validate nor block the bounded renderer IPC POC.
Reject fork, exec, System.cmd, os_mon, and subprocess-dependent release closure rather than returning fake success.
Every admitted operation and flag needs source-plus-trace semantics and positive, negative, error, and race evidence where applicable.
Crypto/TLS and arbitrary NIF security are outside this POC; state that boundary and import no security claim.
Select and test an AArch64 entropy source without transferring RDRAND/RDSEED assumptions.
Keep Phoenix, Nitro, distribution, TLS, wall-clock, throughput, and launch-rate observations classified as Tyn author reports.
Tyn's Alpine 3.19 tag and downloaded OTP URL are not sealed by OCI/source digest in its recipe; do not call the upstream artifact byte-reproducible without independent receipts.
Require paired source, release closure, deterministic image assembly, and build receipts for the exact committed artifacts.
Tyn provides no evidence for the two-process renderer, heartbeat, GPU/input ownership, or BEAM-loss recovery boundary.
